source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Front Suspension, p.3-15

procedures.title: Lower control arm: remove and install
steps: Removal: take out the front coil spring (see Front coil spring: remove and install).
Free the lower ball stud from the knuckle boss (see Lower control arm spherical joint).
Remove the lower control arm from the car.
Installation: put the lower ball stud into the knuckle boss and torque to specification.
Torque the cross shaft bolts to specification.
With the car on the floor, torque the cross shaft bushing bolts to specification.
notes: See figure 23 in the manual for the control arm attachment.
